Completed batch 36. The three draft items define measurement uncertainty, prove exact covariance propagation for the linearized output, and work a correlated calibration example with \(u_c^2=0.0308\) and \(u_c\approx0.1755\). They make no interval, coverage, or asymptotic inference claim. The source coverage includes the [GUM](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/2071204/JCGM_100_2008_E.pdf/cb0ef43f-baa5-11cf-3f85-4dcd86f77bd6), [NIST handbook](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/toolaids/pff/mpc.pdf), and [MIT lecture notes](https://www.ocw.mit.edu/courses/12-s990-quantifying-uncertainty-fall-2012/a1cf07c268b15238d4351c512d31b28b_MIT12_S990F12_Summary.pdf).
